text:
maria.chen: Morning — quick heads-up: I'll be taking the 10:30 PT release train slot for the webhooks rollback-safe deploy (feature/webhook-backoff). Need two quick things before I flip the flag: 1) one last +1 on CR #4523, 2) smoke owner volunteer for EU region. Targeting a 10:40 canary then 11:00 full.
ajones: on CR now, left comments. can give +1 if tests pass.
kevinl: i can be smoke owner for EU. will run smoke checklist. ping me when canary's live.
sophia: Quick reminder: add rollback label to the PR and set canary weight to 5% in rollout config. Also run `./scripts/smoke.sh webhook-service` before validating.
maria.chen: thanks @ajones and @kevinl. PR updated with rollback label and canary config. scheduling: canary 10:40 PT (5%), then 10:55 increase to 50, 11:00 full. tagging deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled: feature/webhook-backoff — canary @1766004000 (10:40), bump @1766004900 (10:55), full @1766005200 (11:00).
tanya: Heads-up for infra: if canary fails, rollback window = immediate; @kevinl will initiate rollback and inform @maria.chen. Ops runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/deploy-rollbacks
ajones: Can confirm tests green. +1 from me. :thumbsup: 
kevinl: Started EU smoke: logs look clean, latency stable. Commands I ran:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh webhook-service --region=eu
kubectl --context=eu-prod logs -l app=webhook -n prod --tail=50
```
maria.chen: Canary looks healthy, bumping to 50% in 2m. @deploy-bot please proceed to step 2.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Bump to 50% in progress... done.
kevinl: 50% stable. No errors in logs. Ready for full rollout.
maria.chen: Flipping to full now. Thanks everyone. I'll post the release notes in #release-updates and tag QA.
